about: Quarantined: Serewater item kinds and the automatic-hit Longsword of Flames kept for recorded histories.

ropekit.name: Climber's harness
ropekit.description: A rope, pitons and fitted harness. Equip it to use supported climbing routes.

wardedlantern.name: Sepulchral lantern
wardedlantern.description: A hooded lantern whose consecrated flame reveals concealed funerary markings. Equip it to read spectral routes.

protectivecharm.name: Ashwood ward charm
protectivecharm.description: A mortuary charm. While equipped: +3 to saving throws and 1 point of damage reduction.

wardblade.name: Warden's blade
wardblade.description: A balanced mortuary blade. While equipped: +2 damage power.

bronzeBearing.name: Bronze censer bearing
bronzeBearing.description: A portable, valuable fragment of the old censer machinery.

register.name: Mortuary register
register.description: A durable record of the dead and the institution that kept their names.

brasskey.name: Cabinet key
brasskey.description: A brass key. It opens only a lock explicitly keyed to this particular item instance.

longsword_of_flames_autohit.name: Longsword of Flames
longsword_of_flames_autohit.description: A steel blade bearing the old foundry ward. Equipped: strike for 1d8 piercing plus 1d6 fire damage.
